source_state_machine.anchor: avg; initialized causally to first valid close
source_state_machine.fibonacci_multipliers: stage 1.. = [1,2,3,5,8,...] following source indexing of array [1,1,...] with fib_n starting at 1
source_state_machine.strict_breach: abs(delta) > threshold; equality is NOT breach
source_update_order: compute threshold from pre-increment stage and current closed-bar ATR
if strict breach, increment stage once only
if incremented stage > max+1, reset anchor to current close and reset stage to 1
signal BUY if new anchor > previous anchor; SELL if new anchor < previous anchor
source_state_machine.alternating_signs: allowed in source because breach predicate uses absolute deviation

atr.true_range: max(H-L, abs(H-prev_close), abs(L-prev_close)) on completed BID bars
atr.smoother: Wilder RMA; seed SMA of first 200 valid TR values, then ATR_t=((199*ATR_prev)+TR_t)/200
atr.warmup: no signal before ATR200 is finite
atr.sequence_start_definition: capture ATR when a stage-1 breach first advances the sequence; retain until anchor reset; clear on reset

mechanism_semantics.PERSIST_SINGLE_STEP: source-faithful stage persistence; at most one stage increment per completed bar
mechanism_semantics.CONSECUTIVE_SINGLE_STEP: at most one increment per completed bar; any bar failing its active threshold resets stage to 1 and clears sequence-start volatility/polarity state
mechanism_semantics.INSTANT_MULTILEVEL: on one completed bar, repeatedly test the same causal close against successive Fibonacci thresholds and advance multiple stages if warranted; finite loop capped by max+1; reset anchor if terminal stage is exceeded
mechanism_semantics.ABSOLUTE: stage progression uses absolute deviation exactly as source; opposite-sign qualifying deviations may contribute to one sequence
mechanism_semantics.SAME_SIDE: first qualifying stage sets polarity; before evaluating each later bar, an opposite-sign delta resets stage to 1, refreshes polarity to the current sign, and the same bar may qualify as a new first stage
mechanism_semantics.CURRENT_BAR_ATR: threshold uses ATR200 of each evaluated completed bar
mechanism_semantics.SEQUENCE_START_ATR: ATR reference captured at first qualifying stage breach and held constant until reset

excluded.CCI: not present in exact source; catalog approximation rejected
excluded.MANUAL_DISTANCE: dimensionful and nonportable across XAUUSD/NQX; may be studied only as separately preregistered asset-specific descendant
excluded.SOURCE_DISPLAYED_TP_SL: informational plots only; no strategy.exit contract
excluded.SESSION_FILTERS: new microstructure hypothesis; forbidden before PnL
excluded.HTF_CONFIRMATIONS: new context family; forbidden before PnL

management_ontology.standardized_stop: on reset signal, stop = reset_anchor - base_distance for BUY; reset_anchor + base_distance for SELL, where base_distance=ATR200(signal_bar)*size; reject if stop is not beyond executable entry after spread/gap

nonselection_robustness_only: alternative signal price source if separately proven by data contract
prerequisites_before_config_hash_freeze: physically materialize and hash exact canonical DEV tick bytes
freeze native timeframe bar alignment from source-clock ticks
